# FC-1D independent reading

Only the supplied packet was used. Unrotated page size 3213 x 4508. Axes: upper 0..6000 psf; lower -100..100 thousandths; displacement labels 0,50,100,150,200,250. The external right legend frame is excluded from calibration. Initial calibration boxes clipped the tilted lower top frame and allowed the upper 1000-psf curve to contaminate a grid track. The boxes and thresholds were corrected before points were read. Final predicted 5000 and 1000 upper lines were checked against visible sections at v~1460 and v~2620 near u=700. Final residuals are below 0.5% of span.

Legend: x=3520; asterisk=2935; square=2345; triangle-down=1468; triangle-up=587; hollow circle=294; solid filled circle=0. The protocol symbol name circle is used for both circle styles; solid circles are explicitly noted. No plus series occurs here.

Upper markers n3520 near u=1739 and u=1855 depart from the drawn fit; n2345 squares near u=1625 and u=1736 lie above the declining fit; n1468 triangle near u=1635 is above its fit. The trace follows the visible smooth author stroke and retains these marker departures. Several early circles have partly missing edges. Broad maxima and the near-flat zero-stress fit make the exact peak abscissa uncertain. The final triangles and square are adjacent to or beyond x=250.

Lower origin/frame symbols overlap, including x/star and up/down triangles; those rows have wide bounds and uncertain assignment notes. A possible additional n3520 x near (820,3354), displacement roughly 38, cannot be separated from the frame/symbol ink and is omitted. The x/star cluster near (888,3354) is particularly uncertain. The triangular pairs near u=1000,1120,1295 share ink. The negative-displacement square near (565,3362) is retained outside the frame. The final n587 triangles, n294 circle and final two n0 filled circles lie above the +100 top frame and are retained using the affine map beyond that frame. Near x=200/250, squares and other symbols share vertical-grid ink.
